answer: Bridge-vault garden: each identity keeps one vault holding a 3 POA bond, opened only by a distinct bridge keeper who re-runs one fresh useful job live. The nth identity from one wallet must open n vaults, each bond costing 3n POA, so the 1st fake risks 3 POA while the 10th risks 300, 1,650 POA across ten. A garden of fakes sharing one keeper's key is exposed and all its vaults are slashed.
